IGUI_TMBan_Bypass: Admins/debug can still play banned songs
IGUI_TMBan_Bypass_Tooltip: When ON, admins and debug users keep authoritative power and can still insert/play banned songs. <LINE> Jukeboxes always enforce bans for everyone (no player context).
IGUI_TMBan_ConfirmText: Apply the ban list? <LINE> <LINE> Banned songs will be blocked from being inserted or played on ALL music devices (cassette, vinyl, CD, jukebox) for every player on the server. <LINE> Songs already playing will not be force-stopped, but cannot be restarted.
IGUI_TMBan_Warning1: WARNING: SET applies the ban list server-wide, for all players and all device types.
IGUI_TMBan_Warning2: Drag songs between the lists (or double-click). Banned songs return when dragged back and SET.
IGUI_TMBan_Blocked: This song has been banned by an admin.
IGUI_Cassette_Yet: I found an old cassette inside!
IGUI_First_Toggle_On: I forgot to toggle it on first.
IGUI_No_Cassette: Oops! I need to put a cassette in first.
IGUI_No_ValidDevice: This device isn't enabled to play cassettes.
IGUI_SWTC_DragCD: Drag a CD here, or right click to remove it.
IGUI_TCClientVolume_Tooltip: Client-side volume control. <LINE> When checked, the volume slider adjusts how loud YOU hear all TrueMoozic music. <LINE> It does not change the device volume other players hear.
IGUI_TM_Jukebox_Empty: Empty - drop cassettes, vinyl or CDs inside
IGUI_TM_Jukebox_QueueMode_Tooltip: When enabled, only songs in the queue play, looping forever.<LINE>Drag songs from the track list into the queue, or double-click a queued song to jump to it.<LINE>Right-click a queued song to remove it.
IGUI_TM_Jukebox_Shuffle_Tooltip: Play tracks in random order. When queue mode is on, the queue is shuffled instead.
IGUI_TMSpeaker_SyncNextTrack: Speaker will sync on next track
